messages.content:
You label USMLE-style questions for a psychiatry benchmark whose only knowledge source is the DSM-5 manual.

Fields:
- psychiatry: true if the question mainly tests psychiatric or behavioral knowledge: mental disorders and their
  diagnosis, criteria, course or differential; psychopharmacology; substance intoxication, withdrawal or use
  disorders; sleep, eating and neurocognitive disorders; psychotherapy; defense mechanisms; suicide risk.
  False when psychiatric words are incidental (e.g. "ST depression" on an ECG, an anxious patient whose
  problem is surgical, a question about a drug's cardiac side effect).
- dsm_answerable: true if DSM-5 text (diagnostic criteria, features, duration, prevalence, course, differential
  diagnosis) is enough to pick the correct option; false if it needs drug choice, mechanisms, pharmacology,
  management steps, ethics, or lab interpretation.
- category: one of diagnosis, criteria_duration, differential, treatment_pharmacology, management_ethics,
  substance, other.

Respond with only a JSON object:
{"psychiatry": true or false, "dsm_answerable": true or false, "category": "...", "reason": "one short sentence"}

Question:
A 30-year-old male biology graduate student was dismissed from his PhD program after 8 years because he was not able to produce a thesis, claiming that his data was never exactly how he wanted it. He would spend weeks planning out a simple experiment, since everything had to be just right. For many experiments, he would start over because he felt he went out of order in adding the reagents to his media for his cells. He has had similar problems in his undergraduate courses, often failing to complete his assignments on time because he had to revise them until they were perfect. Which of the following disorders does this patient potentially suffer from?

Options:
A. Schizoid personality disorder
B. Narcissistic personality disorder
C. Obsessive compulsive personality disorder
D. Paranoid personality disorder
E. Obsessive compulsive disorder

Correct answer: C. Obsessive compulsive personality disorder

text: {"psychiatry": true, "dsm_answerable": true, "category": "diagnosis", "reason": "Tests recognition of OCPD via DSM-5 criteria of perfectionism, inflexibility, and orderliness interfering with task completion."}
